cues.en: Welcome to the chat section of this course, and chat is kind of an odd name for the section, but that's what it's called.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到這門課的對話章節。Chat 作為章節名稱有點奇怪，但大家就是這樣稱呼它。

cues.en: It's called chat completion.
cues.zh: 正式名稱是 Chat Completion，也就是對話補全。

cues.en: But chats are actually much more than chatbots where the name already is, because, of course, we can make chatbots where a human asks
cues.zh: 不過，對話的範圍遠不只是聊天機器人。當然，我們可以做一個讓人類提出

cues.en: a question and an AI answers back.
cues.zh: 問題，再由 AI 回答的聊天機器人。

cues.en: But chat, I put that in quotation marks, is also just something that can happen in a backend system on a schedule.
cues.zh: 但這裡的「對話」，也可能是在後端系統中依照排程執行的事情。

cues.en: So like every day at eight o'clock, go do these steps, often with some tools that we will cover in the next section.
cues.zh: 例如每天早上八點執行這些步驟，常常還會搭配下一章介紹的工具，

cues.en: And send me an email.
cues.zh: 然後寄一封電子郵件給我。

cues.en: That is also technically a chat, but there's no human involved.
cues.zh: 技術上這也是一次對話，但過程沒有人工參與。

cues.en: Yes, the human is the receiver of the email, but the human didn't make it happen at that time at eight o'clock, other than setting up the initial schedule.
cues.zh: 是的，人類會收到郵件，但除了最初設定排程之外，並不是由人類在八點手動觸發。

cues.en: And in the same manner, if you have things, events like webhooks and stuff like that, that can also be the initiator.
cues.zh: 同樣地，Webhook 等事件也可以作為啟動來源。

cues.en: So when a GitHub pull request is made by someone, the AI can make an AI review of that pull request without the user
cues.zh: 例如有人在 GitHub 建立 Pull Request，AI 就能自動審查這個 Pull Request，而使用者

cues.en: doing other than what they normally did, meaning making a pull request.
cues.zh: 除了平常建立 Pull Request 之外，不必多做其他事情。

cues.en: And this is all over in this area begins to become what we call agents, where
cues.zh: 到了這些情境，我們就開始把它稱作代理程式，因為

cues.en: it is more that the system is more autonomous.
cues.zh: 系統的自主性提高了。

cues.en: It's not really autonomous over here.
cues.zh: 但在前面那種情境，其實還不能說是真正自主。

cues.en: And I have had many discussions with other people about what agents are, because this is
cues.zh: 我曾和很多人討論代理程式的定義，因為這種系統

cues.en: not an agent by itself, because at some point, someone wrote this message and chose this schedule.
cues.zh: 本身不完全是自主代理：總有人事先寫好訊息、設定好排程。

cues.en: It was not the AI itself that chose this schedule.
cues.zh: 不是 AI 自己決定那個排程。

cues.en: In the same manner, it was someone who set up the webhook here and made this happen.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這裡也是有人事先設定 Webhook，才讓流程運作。

cues.en: AI is just involved in a bigger scheme.
cues.zh: AI 只是整體系統中的一個環節。

cues.en: And in the old days, behind the scenes, we used if and else statements to do things like this, and the same over here.
cues.zh: 以前我們在背景使用 if、else 判斷來完成這類工作，這裡也是一樣。

cues.en: And we still do.
cues.zh: 現在也仍然會用。

cues.en: We just have now an AI component involved as well.
cues.zh: 只是多加入了 AI 元件，

cues.en: And we suddenly call them agents.
cues.zh: 然後突然就把它們稱為代理程式。

cues.en: So chat is kind of a wrongly named referred nowadays.
cues.zh: 所以，以現在的用途來說，Chat 其實有點名不副實。

cues.en: And it should just be more a request response to some kind of system, just like we can request the weather from a system, just like we can ask things about the
cues.zh: 它更像是對某種系統送出請求並接收回應，就像向系統查詢天氣，或是

cues.en: order from a system using an API.
cues.zh: 透過 API 查詢訂單一樣。

cues.en: We can just ask an AI about some little more undetermined, little more unstructured, little more non-deterministic in a way.
cues.zh: 只是現在改成向 AI 詢問一些比較不明確、比較非結構化，也比較不具決定性的事情。

cues.en: So that is what I see when I see the word chat.
cues.zh: 這就是我看到 Chat 這個字時的理解。

cues.en: It's not just a chatbot.
cues.zh: 它不只是聊天機器人。
